data.title: Damac Bay by Cavalli
data.about:
It has never been more pleasurable to live by the water. Damac Bay is a stunning branded property by Cavalli, a prominent Italian fashion designer, and is the ideal place where sun and sea meet luxury. 

Choose from outstanding one- to three-bedroom apartments or ultra-luxurious three- to five-bedroom flats. This seaside property is located in Dubai’s most popular neighborhood, with unrivaled beach views. Dubai Harbour is the region’s most distinctive and lively neighbourhood, located at the crossroads of the famed Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters. You will also have unique beach access in this magnificently built skyscraper.

location_tile.title: Cavalli’s Damac Bay is unrivaled in terms of splendour and elegance.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
These luxury apartments are located in the heart of Dubai Harbor, amid the region’s most unique waterfront complex. Dubai Harbour, located between Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, is one of Dubai’s most desired coastal regions and home to the region’s biggest marina.

  • The Palm Jumeirah
  • Private Beach
  • Al Maktoum Airport
  • Burj Al Arab
  • Dubai Marina
